_loso_caps_comment: Migrated 2026-09-23: the legacy pooled/shuffled split (cv_fold unset) was removed -- it let the same speaker/recording land in both train and validation, the leakage defect a reviewer flagged as strong-reject on submission 71. cv_fold is now REQUIRED. max_loaded_train_samples/max_validation_samples below are accepted but ignored once cv_fold >= 0; loso_max_* are the caps that actually apply. This is the only remaining flat-schema profile (its nested-schema smoke twin, debug_nested.json, was deleted 2026-09-23 in the unused-profile cleanup -- nothing loaded it by name).
